flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController (POST /plus-apply-suspension), helpers/PermanentSuspensionHelper, helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsRefundNotice/{OcmsRefundNoticeServiceImpl, OcmsRefundNotice}. ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/paymentReport/{helpers/PaymentExceptionReportHelper, jobs/PaymentExceptionReportJob}, resources cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties. No Cumulus code in any of the six repos
note: Status in stories.json: No requirement (the requirement is not given); the story is traced normally from its text. What exists: PS-APP/CAN/CFA/VST on a paid notice creates a refund row (ocms_refund_notice) with refund_notice_id RE{YYYYMMDD}{NNN}, and that row appears in the Daily/Monthly Payment Exception Report. What does not exist: an interface to Cumulus. The word 'cumulus' does not appear in any of the six repos, and thirdpartyapi has no refund code at all. Refund creation is non-blocking: if it fails or amountPaid is empty, the PS is still saved without a refund advice (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:372-376). Sending the report email is switched off in the prod properties (email.enableSmtp=false); the real server value cannot be verified from the repo. PLUS authentication (JwtFilter skips plus-*, relies on APIM) cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: creation of the refund advice and its appearance in the exception report exist. The interface to Cumulus (OCMS46) is not in the repo; do not claim it without evidence from another system. Related tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-075, OCMS-DF-2026-070, OCMS-SR-2026-112.

steps.step: OCMS accepts a permanent suspension (PS-APP/CAN/CFA/VST) from PLUS on an already paid notice
steps.detail: POST /plus-apply-suspension forces suspensionSource=PLUS (SuspensionProcessingController.java:531-543), then processNoticeList -> processSingleNotice calls psHelper.processPS (:546-550, :1053-1055). A paid notice is recognised by crs_reason_of_suspension != null; validatePaidNotice rejects PS codes outside PS_REFUND_CODES with OCMS-4003 (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:180-192, called at :113-117). The code list is read from ocms_standard_code (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:123-126); the content of that table (APP/CAN/CFA/VST) cannot be verified from the repo. PLUS authentication: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS creates a refund advice (an ocms_refund_notice row) for the paid notice that was PS-ed
steps.detail: After VON/eVON/suspended_notice are updated (PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:139-144), createRefundRecord is called (:147). Conditions: the original crs reason is not null and the code is in PS_REFUND_CODES (:324-329), amountPaid > 0 (:332-336). receipt_no is read from ocms_web_txn_detail (txns.get(0), order not specified; a migrated notice without a transaction uses the synthetic receipt MIG-<noticeNo>, :339-347). refund_reason = the PS code when the source is PLUS, 'PSR' otherwise (:352-354). OcmsRefundNoticeServiceImpl.createIfNotExists creates refund_notice_id from a sequence (:55-56) and saves receipt, notice, refund_amount, amount_paid, pp_code, suspension fields and the original CRS (:58-78); if one already exists for receipt+notice, the old ID is returned (:47-52). Edge case: if amountPaid is empty or refund creation errors, the suspension is still saved and the refund is skipped without an error to the caller (:324-336, :372-376). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-075 (PS-APP on a paid notice created no refund, Closed, Prod deployed) is the history of this path; the idempotent re-apply now handles that case (:82-95). OCMS-DF-2026-070 is related (refund details not generated, Closed).

steps.step: The refund advice is interfaced to Cumulus so the refund follow-up can be done
steps.detail: There is no Cumulus interface. The word 'cumulus' (case-insensitive) does not appear in the source, resources or config of the six repos. The refund advice ends as an ocms_refund_notice row (OcmsRefundNoticeServiceImpl.java:78). thirdpartyapi has no refund code at all. In ocmsadminprivateapi, refunds are read only by the report (PaymentExceptionReportHelper.java:121-141) and created by CronSyncTxnData (CronSyncTxnData.java:98-100); there is no outgoing file, SFTP or API call for refunds. The Cumulus interface (Epic OCMS46) may be built in another system: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The refund advice is visible to staff for refund follow-up (Daily/Monthly Payment Exception Report)
steps.detail: PaymentExceptionReportHelper selects ocms_refund_notice rows with cre_date = report date (:121-148) and adds them as exception_type REFUND with refund_notice_id and refund_reason (:164-168). PaymentExceptionReportJob sends an email to the exception recipients (property email.report.paymentreport.exception.recipients, PaymentExceptionReportJob.java:55-56; prod value in application-prod.properties:78; sending :161-170). Daily cron 08:00 enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:255-256), monthly on the 1st at 08:30 (:275-276). But email.enableSmtp=false in application-prod.properties:80, so in the repo email sending is switched off; the real server value cannot be verified from the repo. This is a report channel to URA staff, not a Cumulus interface. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-112 (refund ID/date columns, Closed, Prod deployed).
